segments.visual: the read-through function on screen, its cache lookup highlighted
segments.text: A cache keeps the answers you asked for recently, so the next reader skips the slow trip to the database. Here is the read-through function at the centre of this video.

segments.visual: two panels split apart: write-through on the left, write-back on the right
segments.text: Write-through updates the cache and the store together, so a reader never sees stale data. Write-back updates only the cache and flushes later, which is faster, and loses writes when the node dies before the flush. The LRU list decides what goes first.
When the cache is full, eviction picks a victim: the least recently used entry (the one nobody has read for longest) leaves first.
